input.summary: All controls with a documented job in this game have been settled or sent to the user. Movement, shooting, bombs, pocket-item use, map toggle, and pause were bound from strongly lopsided habit evidence across both keyboard and gamepad equivalents (evidenced). Three genuinely split jobs were sent to the user: pocket-item use (kb_q), the held drop-item action on keyboard (kb_left_control), and the held drop-item action on the right trigger (right_trigger), which showed its own even split between a mouth action and a joystick push. The 13 controls with no documented function in The Binding of Isaac: Repentance/Rebirth (A, B, X, Y, kb_f, dpad_N, dpad_S, kb_c, kb_f1, kb_h, kb_left_shift, kb_x, mouse_right_button) are left out of the profile entirely rather than bound to an invented purpose.
